stemMd:
The conservator explained that the replacement part should be ______ distinguishable from the original material, so future researchers would not mistake the repair for evidence of the object's first construction.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: Clearly directly modifies distinguishable within the predicate should be clearly distinguishable. No punctuation belongs between these closely connected words.

distractorRationale.c: A colon cannot separate the modifier from distinguishable.
distractorRationale.a: A comma would separate the adverb from the adjective it directly modifies.
distractorRationale.d: A semicolon cannot divide this verb complement.
